I want our VP of Engineering (Asha Patel) and CTO (Tom Granger) to see latency/cost guardrails, routing/fallback behavior, and a quick Ops/SLAs overview — the things that matter for a procurement thumbs-up.

This is short notice: next week is tight for our execs but we have three possible 30-minute windows (PST):
- Tue 2027-11-02 10:00–10:30
- Wed 2027-11-03 14:00–14:30
- Thu 2027-11-04 08:30–09:00

Can you confirm availability and whether you can keep it strictly focused on exec questions (no deep architecture walkthrough)? Also: we have a short pre-read (attached) that summarizes our requirements — would appreciate a 3-slide agenda from you to share with the VP.

I've attached the shortlist notes for context. If it's easier, here's our Calendly: calendly.com/stratacore/exec-demo.

Best,

Stratacore Technologies

- 0:00–2:00: Quick intros & goal of the session (Kimberly)
- 2:00–12:00: Latency / cost controls + routing/fallback (Ben)
- 12:00–22:00: Dedicated vs hosted SLOs and SLA commitments (Priyom)
